headline: AJR INFRA AND TOLLING LIMITED: General Updates
sum: General Updates - AJR INFRA AND TOLLING LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Approved the Acquisition of 100% equity stake in Rajahmundry Expressway Private Limited ( REPL ), resulting REPL to become a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the…
